note: Battle maps of HEXZMAP.R3. `chips` are rows of 16-px chip indices into a bank of HEXZCHP entry 0 (80 cells, indices 0–79) followed by entry `chip_set` (indices 80–255); the chip sheets gfx/original/maps/battle/chips-<set>.png show a bank in index order, 16 per row. `terrain` are rows of terrain codes, one per 2×2-chip cell (the 32-px grid units move on); `terrain_table` names the codes. `chip_terrain` counts, for every chip, the terrain codes of the cells it is drawn in over all maps (a guide for mapping chips to terrain; the map's own terrain grid is authoritative).
